content.name: Periapt of Health
entries: You are immune to contracting any disease while you wear this pendant. If you are already infected with a disease, the effects of the disease are suppressed while you wear the pendant.

content.name: Periapt of Health
entries: While wearing this pendant, you can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to regain {@dice 2d4 + 2} {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52}. Once used, this property can't be used again until the next dawn.
In addition, you have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on saving throws to avoid or end the {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} condition while you wear this pendant.
